references.text: Taanach is mentioned as a city in the territory of the tribe of Manasseh, indicating the geographical affiliation of this Levitical city.
Gath-Rimmon was assigned to the sons of Kohath from the half-tribe of Manasseh as a Levitical city with pasturelands.
The Lord's command to give the Levites cities with pasturelands from the inheritances of the other tribes.
The background for the allocation of Levitical cities, where the Levites ask for cities to live in along with pasturelands for their livestock.
A parallel passage in Chronicles describing the allocation of cities to the descendants of Kohath.
Taanach is mentioned again in connection with the territory of the tribe of Manasseh and the cities from which they could not drive out the Canaanites.
Taanach by the waters of Megiddo is mentioned in the Song of Deborah as the place where the kings of Canaan fought.
